Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Norman Powell?

Norman Powell is 33 years old.

Where was Norman Powell born?

Norman Powell was born in San Diego, California.

When was Norman Powell born?

Norman Powell was born on May 25, 1993.

How tall is Norman Powell?

Norman Powell is 6-3 (190 cm) tall.

How much does Norman Powell weigh?

Norman Powell weighs 215 lbs (97 kg).

Is Norman Powell in the Hall of Fame?

Norman Powell is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Norman Powell drafted?

Norman Powell was drafted by Milwaukee Bucks, 2nd round (16th pick, 46th overall), 2015 NBA Draft.

What position does Norman Powell play?

Shooting Guard and Small Forward.

What is Norman Powell's net worth?

Norman Powell has made at least $123,345,746 playing professional basketball.

How much does Norman Powell make?

Norman Powell made $20,482,758 in 2026.

How many rings does Norman Powell have?

Norman Powell has won one championship.

What is Norman Powell's Instagram account?

Norman Powell is on Instagram at normanpowell4.

What schools did Norman Powell attend?

Norman Powell attended Lincoln in San Diego, California and UCLA.

What are Norman Powell's nicknames?

Norm, Stormin Norman are nicknames for Norman Powell.
